enemy-055-albino-chestburster.designLock: PROJECT_ADAPTATION systemic albino derivative of V66 enemy-003-chestburster only: preserve the locked 1979 juvenile identity as one limbless, eyeless, pale ribbed serpentine organism with a smooth rounded elongated head, small metallic teeth and one long ring-segmented tapering tail. Albino changes authored pigment and material response only: warm bone-ivory and pale gray-beige tissue, restrained translucent pink-beige veining and cool gray relief shadows, never flat pure white, glowing, icy or a global recolor. Preserve strict right-facing orthographic profile, base physical scale, cervical root and all idle/move/attack/death anatomy. No arms, legs, adult dorsal tubes, adult xenomorph body, Bambi/Runner anatomy, blood paint or official albino-model claim. Every future pixel must be original project art; canonExact=false.

enemy-055-albino-chestburster.continuityDecision: Alien (1979) and the licensed reference material control the Chestburster base anatomy only. No reviewed licensed source establishes this project's Albino Chestburster as a distinct official model; the albino treatment is an original Tantalus systemic adaptation.

designDetails.silhouette: Inherit the V66 1979-style Chestburster: one smooth elongated rounded skull flowing into a thin limbless ribbed serpentine trunk and one long tapering segmented tail.
designDetails.palette: Warm bone-ivory and pale gray-beige tissue, subtle translucent pink-beige vessels, cool gray relief shadows and small restrained metallic teeth; enough contrast to keep every rib readable.
designDetails.surface: Wet organic juvenile tissue with restrained translucent depth and ring segmentation. The albino result is newly authored material, not a hue-shifted base bitmap.
designDetails.anatomy: One eyeless head, one jaw, small teeth, no inner adult tongue requirement, no arms, no legs, no wings, no dorsal tubes, no adult thorax and exactly one continuous tail.
designDetails.orientation: Strict orthographic gameplay profile facing RIGHT in all 32 poses; head and jaw point right and the body never rotates toward camera.
designDetails.scale: Inherit the reviewed V66 enemy-003 physical scale and per-clip calibration rather than scaling from a changing tail curve. Skull length, rib diameter and cervical junction remain rigid across clips.
designDetails.root: Inherit the base ventral cervical/anterior-trunk physical root and complete lower extraction guard; never root from the tail midpoint or skull center.
designDetails.background: True transparent RGBA when available, otherwise perfectly uniform pure #FF00FF; no shadow, checkerboard, blood, scene, text or grid.
prohibitions: arms, legs, Bambi/Runner limbs, adult biped anatomy or dorsal tubes
flat white silhouette, glow, crystal, ice, snow, fur or automatic recolor
blood-painted toy treatment, gore, human host or emergence scene
left-facing, frontal turn, crop, cell contact, duplicate pose or cross-cell tail
canon-exact, official albino model or 1:1 reproduction claim
